**[@fig-apoe-boxplots]** | **APOE genotype effects on methylation-derived latent dimensions at THR8 (403 CpGs).** Boxplots showing the distribution of the six latent dimensions that differed significantly by APOE functional role (Kruskal-Wallis *P* < 0.05) across six APOE genotypes (ε2/ε2, ε2/ε3, ε3/ε3, ε2/ε4, ε3/ε4, ε4/ε4) in 2,487 [participants]{.rev}, arranged in a 2 × 3 grid. Genotypes are grouped by functional role: Protective (ε2/ε2, ε2/ε3), Neutral (ε3/ε3), and Detrimental (ε2/ε4, ε3/ε4, ε4/ε4), indicated by color-coded background bars. Kruskal-Wallis test [*P* values,]{.rev} computed across the three functional role groups, are shown in red at the top of each panel; orange annotations indicate median values for each genotype.
